en: The postcard is divided into two sections. The upper section features a black and white portrait photograph of a young child with the text 'Hälsning från Sundsvall' in decorative script. The lower section shows an old street scene of a grand boulevard with ornate buildings, pedestrians in early 20th-century clothing, and shop awnings, labeled 'STORGATAN'. The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence in Swedish, with a green Swedish stamp and recipient address.
